'''Satyr Azzlectico''' was a [[King/Legends|king]], who reigned during the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He was toppled by the [[Ailon Nova Guard/Legends|Ailon Nova Guard]], who defeated him by using scouting and ambush tactics.<ref name="Galaxy at War" />
